upgrade.title: The finance office is part of the Premium plan
upgrade.description: Fee structures, receipts, debtor tracking and expenses come with Premium. Your school is on a plan that does not include them yet.

dashboard.title: Finance
dashboard.subtitle: What is billed, what is in, and what is owed
dashboard.nothingBilledDesc: Set a fee structure and invoice a year group to start.
dashboard.noPaymentsDesc: Receipts appear here as money is taken at the desk.

fees.title: Charges
fees.subtitle: Every charge raised, and what is left on it
fees.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, class or ID…

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Take money, and the receipt book behind it
payments.reversed: Receipt reversed. The balance is back on the charge.
payments.failed: That payment could not be recorded.
payments.nothingOwed: This student owes nothing at the moment.
payments.referencePlaceholder: MoMo id, slip or cheque number
payments.noneDesc: Receipts appear here as money is taken at the desk.

debtors.title: Who owes
debtors.subtitle: Worst first, so the office knows where to start
debtors.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, class or ID…
debtors.allSettledDesc: No family has an unpaid charge this term.
debtors.noChargesDesc: Nothing has been billed to this student yet.
debtors.bursaryHint: A discount applied when charges are raised — not a payment. The school never received that money.

structure.title: Fee structure
structure.subtitle: What each year group is charged this term
structure.alreadyInvoiced: Everybody in that year already has this charge.
structure.required: Choose a year, an amount and a due date.
structure.emptyDesc: Set what each year group pays, then invoice them all at once.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Money out: recorded, approved, paid
expenses.recorded: Expense recorded and sent for approval.
expenses.required: A category, a description and an amount are needed.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Money in against money out
reports.noIncomeDesc: Receipts will be grouped here by how they were paid.
reports.noSpendingDesc: Approved expenses will be grouped here by category.

settings.title: Finance settings
settings.subtitle: The rules the office works to
settings.receipt_prefixHint: Receipts are numbered in sequence. Changing this mid-term leaves two prefixes in one book.
settings.late_fee_percentHint: Nothing is charged automatically — this is what the office tells families.
settings.grace_daysHint: Days after the due date before the office starts chasing.
settings.bank_detailsHint: Printed where families are told how to pay.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: What the school pays its staff
payroll.openFailed: That run could not be opened.
payroll.noRunsDesc: Open a run for this month and it fills itself from the salary list.
payroll.deductionNote: Percentages apply to gross pay, not to allowances. The amounts are frozen onto each payslip, so changing a rate never rewrites a payslip already issued.
payroll.noSalariesDesc: Set a salary for each member of staff and a monthly run will build itself.
payroll.noPayslipsDesc: Rebuild this run to fill it from the salary list.

done.pay: Run paid. It now shows as an expense.

cash.title: Cash & bank
cash.subtitle: Where the money actually is
cash.noAccountsDesc: Add the safe, the bank account and any mobile-money float, and every receipt will start landing in one of them.
cash.makeDefault: Money lands here unless the cashier says otherwise
cash.transferFailed: That transfer could not be made.
cash.countNote: This records what you counted. It does not change the books — correcting a difference is a separate, deliberate decision.
cash.noMovementsDesc: Receipts and expenses will appear here as they are recorded.

budget.title: Budget
budget.subtitle: What may be spent, against what has been
budget.createFailed: That budget could not be created.
budget.noneDesc: Set a budget for this term and every expense will be measured against it.
budget.noLinesDesc: Add the categories you plan to spend on and how much each may take.
budget.actualsNote: Actuals count approved and paid expenses. A pending expense is a request, not a commitment, so it is not counted yet.

income.title: Other income & arrears
income.subtitle: Money that is not school fees, and fees from earlier terms
income.noneDesc: Canteen takings, uniform sales, hall hire and donations go here.
income.arrearsNote: Every screen measures the current term, so these balances would otherwise disappear while still being owed.
income.noArrears: Nothing is owed from earlier terms.
income.carryFailed: Those balances could not be carried forward.
